usedFor: Meetings and webinars in Zoom, like “When someone registers for the meeting”, add or update people in Brevo.

bestTemplate.name: “When someone registers for the meeting” in Zoom, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: Each registrant lands in Brevo, and the action updates the contact if it already exists instead of adding a duplicate.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” only takes contacts already in Brevo, so a new registrant needs “Add Or Update Contact” first.
